title: anthemis plutonia var. artemisioides
intro: Anthemis plutonia var. artemisioides, commonly known as wormwood chamomile, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and soothe digestive issues. The health benefits of Anthemis plutonia var. artemisioides include its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia, alleviate menstrual cramps, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
